reuse.why: Routes the existing getScheduledAmount and every inline site through one new getRangeAmount, but the sites keep their own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount, which already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: The range rule now exists once; the remaining null/number/range ternaries at five sites are pre-existing copies the change leaves in place rather than adds.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where schedule amount logic belongs.

scope.why: Only the amount sites, the helper, a focused test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the range rule is a one-line edit, though maintainers still face several copies of the surrounding dispatch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule keep their own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No new duplicated logic; the midpoint copies are replaced by calls to getRangeAmount.

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount (UI), schedule-template, forecast, schedules app and preview transactions.
